theme: An open day before the drive to Virginia.
greeting: A clear calendar today, Dan — no meetings from start to finish. The one thing on the horizon is tomorrow's check-in down in Fredericksburg, plus a short stack of travel bookings that have drifted well past their dates.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Marked book-this-week back on Sept 14 and still open on the Mike + Dan board. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas sells out, and a refundable hold costs nothing to place now.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by-Sept-30, book-by-Oct-15 task is past both dates. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so every day narrows the options.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 drive window closed yesterday. Worth confirming the car actually moved, or the plan falls back to the monthly rental cycle it was meant to replace.

flagged.title: New LinkedIn message from Hans-Kristian
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flags a message waiting on a reply — worth a look given the board search.

flagged.title: Fredericksburg hotel confirmed
flagged.detail: The Hilton confirmation for tomorrow's Oct 20 check-in landed this evening.

inbox.noise: A Duolingo nudge, an academia.edu paper, a Hilton points receipt, and an alumni class-notes note — nothing that needs you.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Autumn's orchard apples are at their peak, and a rustic galette is the simplest way to let them shine.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Place the Portland house order — bedframe & soap holder

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — the morning was yours to spend.
Still open through the afternoon, no meetings to break it up.
The Fredericksburg hotel is booked for tomorrow, so tonight tilts toward getting on the road.
